source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi Stephanie, Good to meet with you again. Just FYI, this is the website of my other company \[<https://ipass.io>\] that I am putting on the back burner while I work on launching Actia. This website was developed the old fashioned way. Don't let the design influence you, although it's fine for the market it is targeting. Mark

value_updates.excluded_design_influence: The iPass website design should not influence the Actia landing-page design.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,
Here's a summary of my feedback:
\* I definitely like examples 1 and 2 over 3 and 4.
\* I do like the "dark mode" landing page. It looks tech but sophisticated. The purple background you created for 1 and 2 looks great.
\* Highlighting the first sentence of the hero text works really well, better than the tag line.
\* I like the look of Alan Sans, at least in the headline text. It feels warmer and more approachable (now they've got me at it!).
\* Surprisingly (to me) the green color works well for buttons.
\* I'm in two minds over the single color vs two color logo
\* Not sure if the screens are a place holder. They could be an interesting approach to explore.
\* Did you envisage adding the rest of the initial copy to the landing page or moving it to follow-on pages?
\* Do you plan to have a common page footer?
I'm looking forward to your next updates.
Mark

value_updates.hero_text_emphasis: Highlight the first sentence rather than the tagline.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Mark! I have a mock-up of the full landing page ready for your review. Here are a few notes:
\- Alan Sans is being used for all the headers
\- I've added some light imagery throughout the site
\- I placed a contact form at the bottom of the page - let me know if you'd like to keep or remove this
\- I added a basic footer because I'm not sure what information you'd like to include here - happy to update it as needed

Looking forward to hearing your feedback!

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that a full landing-page mock-up is ready, with Alan Sans headers and light imagery.

source_message.speaker: client

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Hope you had a good weekend. I've been working on your landing page design and have loaded it up on S3 behind CloudFront. The URL is <https://d2oh0ug4dgao74.cloudfront.net>. I've added some more copy and made a few minor tweaks. I think it's really shaping up. Let me know what you think.

I also implemented tenant dashboard sign-in which works but needs Actia branding. I'm half way through the sign-up wizard and will add it when it's fully working. Can I send you an invite for an Actia login so you can check these out. Let me know the email address to use or if you want me to create an <http://actia.ai|actia.ai> email for you.

I agree with your decision to remove navigation from the header. I'll add links in the footer over time, which seems to be the current trend. I captured a few footers to see what people were doing.

Best,
Mark

execution.observed_behavior: Client reports viewing the landing-page design after deploying it through S3 and CloudFront and positively assesses the rendered result as shaping up.
